verdict.rationale: First-party docs show commands running inside Linux microVMs via the SDK and the `sandbox run` CLI, in blocking or detached mode with streamed logs. Docs also cover system-privileged workloads such as Docker. Package installation is implied rather than shown: snapshots let you "skip dependency installation," and custom images can bake in system packages. Missing for 10: an explicit documented example of installing packages at runtime (e.g., via npm/pip/apt), independent or hands-on corroboration.
